entities.summary: Bruce Alan Lewandowski, CSsR is an American Catholic prelate who has served as Bishop of Providence since 2025. He previously was an auxiliary bishop for the Archdiocese of Baltimore. He is a member of the Redemptorists. Bruce Lewandowski was a religious figures from Toledo (b. 1967-06-08, Toledo). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
